name: Return the Comb
summary: Madame Eva waits in Darkshire for the comb Blind Mary has returned. Its ghostly strands can be spun into Ghost Hair Thread.

sections.title: A Bitter Reflection
sections.body: Blind Mary waits in a shack south of Darkshire, mourning her death and the change it brought. Madame Eva’s comb reminds her of mortal grooming, and deepens her sorrow. She sees only an apparition, a monster stripped of mortal grace, certain no one can love her again. In horror, she thrusts the comb and the ghostly hair tangled in its teeth back into your hands.

sections.title: Weaving the Supernatural
sections.body: Madame Eva awaits the comb in Darkshire, knowing the task was grim. The ghostly hair gives the fortune teller what she needs to spin a spool of Ghost Hair Thread. She pays you for any strands left over after the delicate work.

faq.q: Why does Blind Mary react with horror to the comb?
faq.answer: The comb reminds Blind Mary of her mortal life and beauty. Seeing herself as a withered spirit overwhelms her with grief, and she rejects the comb, lamenting that she has become a monster no one will cherish.

faq.q: What does Madame Eva do with the hair on the comb?
aliases: what does eva do with ghost hair
faq.answer: Madame Eva weaves the hair from the comb into Ghost Hair Thread, a mystical thread used to bind evil spirits and sew life into inanimate objects.
Blind Mary haunts a dilapidated shack south of Darkshire, near Tranquil Gardens Cemetery in Duskwood.
Madame Eva is a human mystic and diviner who lives in Darkshire. She offers fortune readings, cryptic guidance, and magical trinkets and reagents to those facing Duskwood’s dangers.

faq.q: What follows after returning the comb to Madame Eva?
aliases: next quest after return the comb
faq.answer: After taking the comb and preparing the Ghost Hair Thread, Madame Eva asks you to deliver it to Abercrombie, the hermit near Raven Hill Cemetery.

faq.q: Why does Madame Eva give you coins upon completion?
faq.answer: Madame Eva says the comb held more than enough ghostly hair for the spool. She gives you a few coins for the surplus strands she keeps.

angles.text: Spinning Ghost Hair Thread shows how Duskwood’s spectral material can be harvested and carded into durable supernatural textiles.
Blind Mary’s self-loathing reveals the torment of spirits bound to the mortal world by grief rather than malice.
The gloomy roads between Darkshire and Mary’s home expose travelers to the decay gripping Duskwood.
